dedupe_keys.name: jodi gas world database monthly natural gas and lng production trade stocks and deliveries for about 80 countries

description: The JODI-Gas World Database gives all data reported through monthly submissions of the JODI-Gas Questionnaire by participating countries and economies, modelled on JODI-Oil with the aim of transparency for global energy security. It covers three product units, natural gas in million cubic metres and in terajoules and LNG in thousand tonnes, and twelve flows: production, receipts from other sources, LNG imports and exports, pipeline imports and exports, stock change, gross inland deliveries calculated and observed, deliveries for electricity and heat generation, statistical difference and closing stocks. Data from national oil and gas companies are verified by national administrations and passed to the partner organisations. Coverage is around 80 participating countries, with history from January 2009 and a target of releasing data one month old each month; the database is updated around the 20th of each month. The complete series are free to download in a beta CSV format, with a manual and a list of participating economies; the website terms of use apply and no data licence is stated. Caveats: reporting completeness varies by country. Simulation uses are gas supply, LNG import and storage inputs for security of supply and disruption scenarios. Related records: data-jodi-oil-world-database is the oil counterpart.
